question: Which ordering correctly ranks the five states by total increase in mortality rate from 2019 to 2022? (A) California, Pennsylvania, Florida, Texas, New York (B) Florida, California, Pennsylvania, Texas, New York (C) New York, Texas, Florida, Pennsylvania, California. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: A (A). Bait: B (B).
